scope: PostgreSQL 18 compatibility evidence and remaining gates

items.postgresql_reference: PostgreSQL 18 parser sources pinned by parser_chain
items.open_issue: The top-level statement and semantically relevant option inventory is not complete.
Trigger, partition, and complete MERGE-action differential coverage remains.

items.postgresql_reference: PostgreSQL 18 CREATE TABLE constraint grammar and catalogs
items.open_issue: NOT VALID, ALTER CONSTRAINT, and complete dump/reopen coverage remain.

items.postgresql_reference: PostgreSQL 18 functions and operators covered by the PG18 semantic suite
items.open_issue: The complete PostgreSQL 18 function, type, overload, and catalog matrix remains.
Complete collation, locale-provider, ownership, ACL, and database lifecycle behavior remains.

items.postgresql_reference: PostgreSQL 18 PL/pgSQL statements and cursor documentation
items.open_issue: Session portal state is required for refcursor parameters, returns, and cursors surviving routine exit.

items.postgresql_reference: PostgreSQL 18 frontend/backend protocol 3.2 message formats and flow
items.open_issue: Credentialed GSS, non-trust authentication, extended-query, binary-format, and broader live-driver coverage remain.
Definition, dependency, catalog, read, DML, dump, and reopen behavior are not implemented.

items.postgresql_reference: PostgreSQL 18 CREATE TABLE WITHOUT OVERLAPS and PERIOD constraints
items.open_issue: Range and multirange carriers, operators, indexes, and temporal constraint enforcement are not implemented.

items.postgresql_reference: PostgreSQL 18 core regression and isolation schedules
items.open_issue: The complete core regression and isolation schedules have not been imported and classified.

items.postgresql_reference: PostgreSQL 18 client-visible SQL, protocol, dump/restore, and operational behavior
items.open_issue: JDBC, Npgsql, psycopg, pgx, node-postgres, migration, introspection, dump/restore, pooling, recovery, and administration coverage remain.
